findings.citation_text: Building on this idea, Ning et al. [30] introduced MoiréPose, extending the approach to 6-DoF pose estimation in camera-to-screen interaction scenarios.

findings.citation_text: Although these works highlight the strong potential of moiré-based sensing, their performance remains constrained by controlled setups, dedicated gratings, and limited sample rates.
